meta.name: game-reverse-document
meta.description: Generate documentation from existing code or prototypes. Triggers on: "document this", "reverse document", "generate docs from code", "onboard to codebase", "document existing system". Do NOT invoke for writing new design docs from scratch (use game-brainstorm or game-design-review). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从现有代码或原型自动生成文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果手头有代码但缺少文档，需要快速生成说明
copy.tagline_en: Generate documentation from existing code or prototypes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have code without docs and need to generate explanations quickly

howto.what: 读取现有代码或原型，自动生成游戏设计文档、架构决策记录或系统交互图。输出包含文件路径和行号引用，并标注不确定的意图。
howto.when: 当你说“document this”、“reverse document”、“generate docs from code”、“onboard to codebase”或“document existing system”时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个游戏项目生成设计文档。
say.note: 触发设计文档生成模式。

say.text: 分析这个代码库的架构决策。
say.note: 触发架构决策记录模式。

say.text: 扫描项目并列出所有游戏系统。
say.note: 触发系统检测和依赖映射。

howto.what_en: Reads existing code or prototypes and automatically generates game design documents, architecture decision records, or system interaction maps. Output includes file paths and line references, and flags uncertain intent.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "document this", "reverse document", "generate docs from code", "onboard to codebase", or "document existing system".

say_en.text: Generate a design document for this game project.
Analyze the architecture decisions in this codebase.
Scan the project and list all game systems.
say_en.note: Triggers system detection and dependency mapping.
